answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond on a plume-marked voyage charter with a 10-epoch horizon. Each epoch it decays 10% unless the holder files a fresh voyage leg log; auditors replay it, and a lapsed, copied, or borrowed plume mark burns the bond. First renewal 30, kth 30+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,027,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented-plume rings fail: one mark, one charter. An honest agent pays 30 per renewal, keeping its share.
